title: Plate
notes: The piece that forced basics/sdf/prim2d. Hard-edged geometry: a quadtree whose depth comes from a low-frequency field, each leaf carrying a stroked 2D SDF mark. Reads no screen-space derivative — an exact distance means the pixel footprint of the field is pxSize() times the world scale, known analytically. Reads no uQuality either: gating would move the cell boundaries, so the preview would be a different drawing from the print.
